sources.title: Nanbeige4.2-3B: Unlocking Agentic Capabilities in a Compact Model
sources.snippet: We present Nanbeige4.2-3B, a compact general agentic model with 3B non-embedding parameters. It delivers strong performance across code-agent, office-agent, and complex tool-use tasks while maintaining highly competitive reasoning capabilities in mathematics, coding, and science.
